_meta.role: Embedded Software Engineer II, Charging & Energy

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands on embedded C/C++ experience spanning STM32 bare metal firmware, FreeRTOS real time task coordination, and Jetson based Linux systems. Built a three layer robotic control pipeline connecting a Flutter client, a Flask SocketIO edge server, and an embedded Jetson and Arduino controller over a unified WebSocket protocol fabric, working directly with UART and I2C peripheral communication. Comfortable writing real time embedded C/C++ and scripting development and test tooling in Python and Bash.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition device integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary, Agnel Robotics Club
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and firmware integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a three-layer distributed embedded pipeline on a Jetson Linux target: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.

Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through systematic debugging; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++, driving five servos with interrupt-driven, range-gated contact detection via I2C sensor mux.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver; programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1).
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination across multi-servo PWM control and interrupt-driven UART command handling.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing over I2C for range gated tracking with OLED distance visualization and user override.
